label: late absolute step (t=7-9) of original phase / <DEL>, boosted by accumulated y/3/e/u/g/2/t/j/k tokens
explanation: Fires only at absolute steps t=6-9 (about 99.8% of activations), i.e. the last original tokens and the <DEL> step of long sequences (L=8-9 carry ~96% of mass); essentially never fires in the copy phase (13 activations) or at t<=5 or t>=10. Within this window it acts like an accumulator: it is more likely and stronger when the input or earlier inputs include tokens y, 3, e, u, g, 2, t, j, k (in_tok lift: y 3.4x, 3 3.1x, e 2.6x, u 2.1x), and on first occurrences of a token. The top activations are on y/3/e/u/2 inputs at t=7-8 in L=8-9 sequences, often continuing into <DEL>. Requiring t in 7-9 plus at least 3 such tokens seen gives dev F1 0.32, mass recall 0.81; the time window alone has recall 0.92 but precision 0.12. Precision stays low because the unit fires on only ~6% of steps in its window, and the exact token weighting that sets it off is graded and not captured by a simple set.
